releaseNotes: 新增固定静态作品网站发布链：冻结公开候选、构建并验证唯一 Netlify draft Deploy，再提升同一 Deploy。
静态站公开运行时不依赖 Worker、D1、KV/R2 或 API；固定链接和二维码只在第一次生产读回成功后显示。
静态导出采用 30 分钟一次性 bootstrap 与最长 120 分钟可撤销租约，令牌只存摘要且按 Job、代次、方法和媒体白名单绑定。
新增 D1 向前兼容 migration 0008；旧 published_json 不回填来源，静态公开 revision 从 0 独立计数。
旧限制访问写操作暂停并返回 ACCESS_FEATURE_PAUSED，既有设置、访问码、次数和到期数据全部保留。
版本比较统一使用受控 SemVer 解析器；1.3.0 < 1.3.1-b < 1.3.1。
原 1.3.1 仍保持搁置；本 Candidate 不创建 Tag、Site、Deploy 或任何生产资源。

newDeploymentPolicy.templateResourceIdentity: bindings only; no database_name, database_id or KV id
newDeploymentPolicy.effectiveWorkerName: validated WRANGLER_CI_OVERRIDE_NAME when provided, otherwise validated wrangler name

upgradePolicy.eligibility: v1.1+ or an equivalent older install with fixed DB and MEDIA_KV resource ids and matching live bindings
upgradePolicy.preDeployFingerprintRequirement: strictly equal the before fingerprint after verified source convergence and exact original wrangler.jsonc restoration
upgradePolicy.baselineWritePolicy: exclusive 0600 create; preserve across retries; existing path fails closed; owner-confirmed archive before a new upgrade round
upgradePolicy.cloudBuildScope: first deployment only; existing Worker fails closed and this is never an upgrade entry
fingerprintCoverage: optional R2 binding and bucket name
runtime variable binding, type and value SHA-256
upgradePolicy.manualWorkersDevBaseline: record and revisit the remote workers.dev setting and full URL separately
upgradePolicy.legacySourceSequence: verify refs/tags/v1.3.1-b in a detached worktree outside the original site repository directory; invoke that tag tool by absolute path so it pins Wrangler cwd and dependencies to the verified tag root while reading the original absolute wrangler.jsonc, then converge verified tracked source into the original worktree while restoring that config
upgradePolicy.dirtyWorktreePolicy: record original branch and commit; fail closed until owner-confirmed recoverable save; never force checkout or reset --hard
preserve: existing Worker identity and workers.dev hostname
D1 DB binding, resource id, migrations and all stored portfolio data
MEDIA_KV binding, resource id and all uploaded media
the same legacy BUCKET binding and source objects while any R2 media rows remain
Cloudflare secrets and runtime variable names
access passes, analytics and audit records

legacyMedia.sourceObjectVersion: pin original R2 httpEtag and fail closed on change
legacyMedia.finalVerification: resumable final-verifying phase rereads every current KV chunk and compares it with the copy ledger
legacyMedia.backendSwitch: compare-and-swap only after the complete final-verification ledger matches
legacyMedia.schema1HeroPolicy: map original media key into the current hero
legacyMedia.schema1DraftVideoPolicy: administrator-readable private document archive reference; strip before returning public JSON and omit from preview and playback
